mapper.select: select * from lims_instrument_data_acquisition where instrument_id = #{instrumentId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into lims_instrument_data_acquisition( instrument_id, instrument_code, interface_type, connection_config, data_protocol, parsing_rules, field_mappings, auto_import, poll_interval, status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{instrumentId}, #{instrumentCode}, #{interfaceType}, #{connectionConfig}, #{dataProtocol}, #{parsingRules}, #{fieldMappings}, #{autoImport}, #{pollInterval}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from lims_instrument_data_acquisition where acquisition_id in #{acquisitionId}
